title: Extending MPI Correctness Benchmarking to the Fortran Language
problem: MPI correctness benchmarks (test suites for MPI implementations) exist for C but not Fortran, despite MPI standard supporting both languages; Fortran MPI code quality assessment incomplete
motivation: Fortran remains widely used in scientific computing for high-performance code. Correctness tool evaluation previously focused on C; Fortran gaps mean MPI tool quality for Fortran codes unknown, creating risk for scientific applications.
method: Porting MPI-BugBench (most recent MPI correctness benchmark) test generation logic to Fortran; identification of language-specific porting challenges; comparative accuracy evaluation of MUST (dynamic MPI correctness tool) on C and Fortran
key_novelty: First extension of MPI correctness benchmarking to Fortran language, revealing language-specific tool accuracy differences
contributions: Porting of MPI-BugBench test generation to Fortran
Comparative accuracy evaluation of MUST on C vs Fortran
Discovery of OpenMPI Fortran binding bugs
Discovery of MPI-BugBench test case generator bugs
Expanded coverage of MPI correctness tools

metrics.comparison: C vs Fortran accuracy in MUST

limitations: Abstract lacks specific accuracy numbers; bug discovery mentioned but not detailed; limited to MUST tool (other Fortran MPI checkers not evaluated)
primary_theme: MPI Tool Quality for Fortran Scientific Code
